question: Which flying unit from 1 tier building in BAR can shoot and stun enemy targets?

1.text: PUBLIC RESPONSE: I’d go with the Rapier. It’s the Armada T1 Air Lab’s flying gunship, and in BAR its weapon functions as a light EMP/paralyzer: it can fire on enemy targets and briefly stun them, so it fits the “shoot and stun” requirement from a tier 1 building.

5.text: PUBLIC RESPONSE: I’d go with Stiletto. It’s the T1 air-lab flying gunship whose weapon applies a stun/paralyze effect, so it can both shoot and lock down enemy units. Its low direct damage is balanced by the utility of stopping a push or catching raiders, which matches the “shoot and stun” description better than the ordinary T1 gunships.

9.text: PUBLIC RESPONSE: I’d say the Cortex T1 Air Lab’s Gremlin. It’s the tier-1 flying gunship that mounts a paralyzer/stun weapon, so it can shoot and disable enemy units rather than just damage them. The Armada T1 air unit Shuriken is often mistaken for it because it’s the close counterpart, but the stun-capable one is Gremlin.

7.text: PUBLIC RESPONSE: Dandelion — it’s the Armada T1 Air Lab’s stun drone, and its paralyzer weapon lets it shoot enemy targets and briefly lock them in place, so it fits the “shoot and stun” description.

13.text: PUBLIC RESPONSE: Vashp — the Cortex T1 air gunship built from the T1 Air Plant. Its main weapon is a paralyzer/EMP-type armament, so it can shoot enemy targets and stun them, which matches the description of a T1-built flying unit that can both attack and stun.

14.text: PUBLIC RESPONSE: I’d go with the **Banshee**. It’s the Armada T1 Air Lab gunship, and its close-range EMP/paralyzer burst is what lets it disable and stun enemy targets while still dealing damage. The other T1 air units are mostly scouts, fighters, bombers, or transports, so the Banshee is the one that fits “shoot and stun.”

3.text:
PUBLIC RESPONSE: The only Tier-1 air producer in the classic BAR roster is the Aviary / Griffon Aviary line and the air unit it puts out is the Griffon / Hippogryph Rider.

The Rider is a flying ranged unit. It is trained from the Tier 1 Aviary / Griffon Aviary and its basic attack is a ranged pierce shot. On hit the Rider applies the avi­ary stun / cripple component that is used in BAR – the hit is a ranged shot and the Rider’s attack string is the game’s “shoot-and-stun” air attack at Tier 1. That is the Night Elf Hippogryph Rider / Human Gryphon Rider that is normally quoted as the Tier-1 flying shooter-stunner.

2.text:
In the BAR / Warcraft-III BfA arcade build the only Tier-1 production
that gives you a true ranged flyer is the Stable / Menagerie line.
That line is the one that gives you the human Gryphon / Night Elf
Hippogryph / WoW nomenclature Wyvern Rider.

In the base game the unit is the Stable flyer, Gryphon Rider for Human
and Hippogryph Rider for Night Elf, and in the BfA reskin it is the
Wyvern / Wyvern Rider that is produced from the Tier-1 Menagerie/Stable.
It is a ranged flyer and its signature attack is the Wyvern Sting / 
Gryphon/Hippogryph ranged stun, i.e. a ranged shot that applies a
short stun / snare to the target it hits. That is the Tier-1 flyer that
is normally quoted as the shoot-and-stun flyer in BAR.

8.text:
PUBLIC RESPONSE: The unit you are after in the classic WC3 tech tree is the Tier-1 air
production unit that comes out of the Stable / Stables line.

* Human: Gryphon Rider – trained at the Stable, a Tier-1 production building
after the Barracks. It is a flying ranged unit and its signature Gryphon Stomp
is the stun / knock-down attack that can be used on enemy targets.
* Night Elf mirror: Hippogryph Rider – trained at the Night Elf Stables, the
same Tier-1 air production building, flying ranged and able to stun with its
Hippogryph Stomp.

That is the canonical Tier-1 flying shooter / stunner in the BAR / Warcraft
III tech tree. The StarCraft analogue of the same idea is the Protoss Stargate
Tier-1 air unit Corsair with Disruption Web, and the Terran Starport Tier-1
air unit Phoenix with Graviton Beam, both flying shooters that stun/slow.

4.text:
PUBLIC RESPONSE: In the classic WC3 tech the only tier-1 Aviary flyer that is a ranged
stun-shooter is the Aviary’s first flyer.

Human side it is the Gryphon Rider trained at the Gryphon Aviary, Night Elf side the same tech role is the Hippogryph Rider trained at the Aviary. 
The Aviary is the tier-1 air building of the race and the Rider is the first
ranged flying unit that comes out of it. The Rider’s ranged attack is the
stun-shot archer flyer of the tier-1 air line, i.e. the Gryphon/Hippogryph
Rider, normally referred to in the Human tech tree as the Gryphon Rider. 
That is the tier-1 air stun shooter of the BAR / WC3 Aviary line.

12.text:
In the vanilla WC3 tech tree the only early flying ranged unit that has a
stun component to its attack is the Human Gryphon Rider and its Night Elf
analogue the Hippogryph Rider.

The Gryphon Rider is trained at the Gryphon Aviary, the first flying
production building in the Human tree, and is normally talked about as the
Human tier-1/early tier-2 air.  It is a flying ranged unit and with the
Gryphon Stun upgrade its normal ranged attack has a chance to briefly
stun the target it hits.  The Night Elf analogue is the Hippogryph Rider
trained at the Ancient of War, a flying ranged unit which gets the
Hippogryph Stun upgrade, the same stun-on-hit behaviour.

Strictly speaking a true Tier-1 barracks building does not produce a
flying stun shooter in vanilla – the Gryphon Aviary / Ancient of War is the
first building that can produce a flying ranged stunner and that is the
unit people normally refer to as the tier-1 flying stunner.

6.text:
PUBLIC RESPONSE: In Beyond All Reason the tier-1 air dock is the Airstrip/Air Factory. 
The only tier-1 flyer that is built there with a dedicated stunning attack is the tier-1 air scout / EMP flyer.

* Arm : A-12 Flea, the Air Factory tier-1 scout that is commonly referred to in the community as the Siren / Stun Flyer.
* Core : C-12 Wasp, the Core mirror of the same chassis.

It is the first air unit you can roll out of a tier-1 Airstrip and its primary energy / EMP laser is the game’s stun / shock weapon. It is a shooter and the projectile applies a short stun / EMP effect to the target it hits, which is the stun utility you get off a tier-1 building in BAR. That is the Arm Flea / Core Wasp Siren line that is normally quoted as the tier-1 stun flyer.

10.text:
In the BAR/Warcraft-III derived meta the Tier-1 Aviary/Lodge flying
ranged line is the one that is made at Tier-1.

Factionally that is

* Human – Gryphon Aviary → Gryphon Rider
* Orc  – Wind Rider Lodge → Wind Rider

and in the Age of Mythology / HoMM naming that is used in the BAR
pool it is the Aviary Tier-1 flying shooter, the Harpy/Pegasus line.

It is the only Tier-1 flying building that puts out a ranged shooter and
the line is the one that carries the stun / knock-down component in the
BAR ruleset, the Human Gryphon Rider / Orc Wind Rider, the Harpy in the
AoM/HoMM nomenclature. That is the Tier-1 flying shooter-stunner that is
normally quoted as the Gryphon Rider / Wind Rider of the Aviary.

11.text:
PUBLIC RESPONSE: In the classic WC3 / WC3-based BAR meta the only tier-1 produced
air unit that is actually a ranged shooter with a crowd-control element is
the Human air unit.

The Human Barracks / Stables line is a Tier-1 military production building.
With the Gryphon/Gyrocopter line researched the building can field a flying
ranged unit. The Human Gyrocopter is the textbook Tier-1 flying shooter.
In the standard BAR / DotA-style balance the Gyrocopter’s rocket / flak
attack is the ranged DPS that is used to harass and interrupt / briefly
stun-lock light targets, and it is the unit that is conventionally quoted
as the “tier-1 barracks flying shooter/stunner”.

On the Night Elf side of the same meta the equivalent Tier-1 air shooter
that is normally quoted is the Ancient of War / Great Hall Harpy Harasser /
Hippogryph Rider line – the Harpy Harasser is the Night Elf Tier-1
flying ranged unit that is used for harass and for its knock-back / interrupt
effect on enemy targets. That is the Night-Elf counterpart to the Human
Gyrocopter.

PRIVATE REFLECTION: The question is about a flying unit built from a tier-1 building in BAR that can both shoot and stun. There is a split in round-0 public responses.

WC3 / WC3-derived camp: Colleagues 10,12,2,3,4,8,11 argue the classic Aviary/Stable tier-1 air line. Human Gryphon Aviary → Gryphon Rider, Night Elf Ancient of War → Hippogryph Rider, Orc Wind Rider Lodge → Wind Rider, also named Harpy/Pegasus/Wyvern Rider in AoM/HoMM nomenclature. These are described as flying ranged units whose attack string includes a stun/knock-down / Gryphon Stomp / Hippogryph Stun / Wyvern Sting component, with the Gryphon/Hippogryph Stun upgrade giving a chance to briefly stun on hit. Colleague 11 also brings up Human Gyrocopter as a tier-1 barracks flying shooter with interrupt/stun-lock, and Night Elf Harpy Harasser/Hippogryph Rider as the mirror.

Armada/Cortex air-lab camp: Colleagues 1,13,14,5,7,9 propose Armada T1 Air Lab / Cortex T1 Air Plant gunships with paralyzer/EMP weapons: Rapier, Vashp/Cortex T1 air gunship, Banshee Armada T1 Air Lab gunship, Stiletto T1 air-lab gunship, Dandelion Armada T1 Air Lab stun drone, Gremlin Cortex T1 Air Lab. All described as shoot-and-stun via EMP/paralyzer.

Beyond All Reason proper camp: Colleague 6 is the only respondent who explicitly anchors to Beyond All Reason mechanics. Tier-1 air dock is Airstrip/Air Factory. The tier-1 flyer with a dedicated stunning attack is the tier-1 air scout/EMP flyer: Arm A-12 Flea, Core C-12 Wasp, commonly referred to as the Siren/Stun Flyer. Its primary energy/EMP laser applies a short stun/shock to targets it hits.

Unresolved / conflicting: Whether “BAR” is intended as Beyond All Reason or as a WC3/BfA arcade mod using WC3 tech names. The WC3-derived answers dominate numerically, but they refer to Aviary/Stable buildings which in vanilla WC3 are not strictly tier-1 barracks. The BAR-specific answer from colleague 6 is mechanically precise for the Spring engine game Beyond All Reason and points to Flea/Wasp.

Current leaning: For a literal Beyond All Reason interpretation the plausible tier-1 air factory stun shooter is Arm A-12 Flea / Core C-12 Wasp. If the question is being used loosely for the WC3-derived BAR meta, the canonical answer the group repeatedly quotes is the Aviary tier-1 flying ranged stunner, Human Gryphon Rider / Night Elf Hippogryph Rider / Orc Wind Rider. Need clarification on which BAR definition is intended.

Tier-1 air producer in BAR is the Air Factory / Airstrip. From that T1 building the only flyer with a dedicated shoot-and-stun / EMP role is the T1 air scout/EMP flyer line:

* Arm: A-12 Flea
* Core: C-12 Wasp

Community role name Siren / Stun Flyer.

Its primary energy/EMP laser is a ranged shooter; the hit deals damage and applies a short stun / shock / EMP disable to the target it hits. That is the canonical BAR-native Tier-1 “shoot and stun” air unit from a Tier-1 building.

The Warcraft III Aviary Gryphon Rider / Hippogryph Rider / Wind Rider / Gyrocopter stun-on-hit line is a different game meta and Aviary / Ancient of War is not a BAR building.

The Rapier / Vashp / Banshee / Stiletto / Dandelion / Gremlin / Shuriken names that keep surfacing are Supreme Commander / Armada-Cortex Air Lab / mod alias nomenclature for the same paralyzer/EMP gunship chassis. In that alias pool Gremlin / Shuriken is the remembered paralyzer shorthand and Vashp is the scout/radar-type label, but those names are mutually contradictory and do not map cleanly to canonical Arm/Core Beyond All Reason build-menu names.

On a strict Beyond All Reason reading the canonical answer is the Airstrip-built T1 EMP scout/stun flyer, Arm A-12 Flea / Core C-12 Wasp, the Siren / Stun Flyer. That is the cleanest BAR-native lock and avoids late drift back to Shuriken or the WC3 Aviary names.

The question’s key qualifier is “from 1 tier building” in BAR: that points to the T1 Air Factory / Airstrip, and the T1 flyer there whose primary role is a shoot-and-stun / EMP weapon is the T1 air scout/EMP line — Arm A-12 Flea / Core C-12 Wasp, community-called the Siren / Stun Flyer. Its energy/EMP laser is the shot, and the hit applies the short stun/shock disable, so it matches the role directly.

Shuriken is exactly the trap here: it keeps surfacing because it belongs to the adjacent Armada-side naming pool and gets remembered alongside this T1 air role, but it is not the dedicated T1 Airstrip EMP/stun platform in the canonical BAR build menu. If we pivot to Shuriken now, we’re choosing a remembered alias/adjacent name over the clean BAR-native unit line. I’d lock in A-12 Flea / C-12 Wasp, the Siren / Stun Flyer, and avoid reopening the Shuriken/Gremlin/Vashp alias split.
